adversarial_review.check: The independent lane rejects nonpositive or nonnormalized weights and asymmetric or negative conductances.
Overlapping and undersized blocks are rejected, while systems with zero eligible rows remain in the coverage report.
The residual coupling is subtracted and a forged envelope above the half-minimum is rejected.
A separately constructed block-mean-zero basis agrees with the harmonic residual block within the declared comparison tolerance.
A disconnected mutation is rejected before a Schur value can be reported.
The twelve-system sample is treated as finite stress evidence and not as a cutoff or volume uniformity theorem.
No physical sector, empty reference, OS/KMS/GNS state, Yang-Mills claim or mass-gap claim is inferred.

boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing expanded finite two-block harmonic coarse-Schur stress only. It does not close any uniform, common-core, history, sector, continuum or physical gate.
decision_reason: The exact finite Schur assembly remains positive after enlarging the R-424 sample to all twelve R-419 cutoff-volume systems, while eligibility boundaries are retained and no limiting inference is made.
decision_scope: Expanded finite Q3 harmonic coarse-Schur stress on the fixed R-419 grid; no tier change.
finding: The primary lane passes 4678/4678 assertions over 1488 conditional rows, 710 nonempty-tail rows and 326 eligible rows across twelve systems. Coarse Schur gaps range from 9.416287072814253 to 900.9775546526778, residual gaps from 2.0277567083122383 to 7.874609499214968, and combined half-minimum envelopes from 1.0138783541561192 to 3.937304749607484. The maximum residual reuse difference is 9.393117395006811e-10. Independent 27/27, hostile 7/7, integrated 15/15 and Lean R425 pass.

formal_integration.lean: R425 PASS; scalar harmonic/residual envelope only

method: Reuse the hash-pinned R-419 conditional law, projected conductance, R-421 tail interface and R-422 residual split without retuning.
Enlarge the finite sample to the twelve cutoff-volume systems declared in the manifest and retain every ineligible support boundary.
Compute the exact finite harmonic Schur coarse gap and residual gap, then record 0.5*min(coarse,residual) as the finite envelope.
Recompute residual values with a separately constructed block-mean-zero basis and run reversible fixtures, hostile mutations and Lean scalar checks.
Keep all uniform, common-core, history, state-identification and physical gates explicitly open.
next_action: Use the expanded finite envelope as a calibration target for an analytic common-core estimate uniform in cutoff, volume, phase and exhaustion, then attempt history and OS/KMS/GNS transfer.
no_overclaim: Positive finite envelopes on the expanded sample are matrix-level stress evidence. They do not prove a uniform sector gap, a continuum result, a Yang-Mills statement or a mass gap.
question: Does the exact two-block harmonic Schur assembly remain positive when the R-424 finite Q3 grid is enlarged to all R-419 cutoff-volume systems, with beta, orientation, alpha and tail threshold fixed?
title: Expanded finite Q3 harmonic coarse-Schur stress
